description: This file defines the PHP class 'tlReqMgrSystem' which manages request system entities within the TestLink project. It includes methods for CRUD operations, linking systems to projects, fetching system types, and establishing connections. The class interacts with a database and references external interface implementations based on system types.

classes.name: tlReqMgrSystem
classes.description: Class responsible for managing request system entities, including CRUD operations, linking systems to projects, retrieving types, and interface instantiation based on system type.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with a database connection and populates system types.

methods.name: getSystems
methods.description: Returns systems filtered by their enabled/disabled status.

methods.name: getTypes
methods.description: Returns a mapping of system codes to their type descriptions.

methods.name: getImplementationForType
methods.description: Returns the interface implementation class name for a given system type.

methods.name: getEntitySpec
methods.description: Returns the schema specification for the system entity.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new system entry in the database after sanitizing input.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing system's data in the database.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a system entry if it is not linked to any test project.

methods.name: getByID
methods.description: Retrieves a system record by its ID.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieves a system record by its name.

methods.name: getByAttr
methods.description: Retrieves a system record based on specified attribute criteria.

methods.name: sanitize
methods.description: Sanitizes and validates input object for creating or updating records.

methods.name: link
methods.description: Creates or updates a link between a system and a test project.

methods.name: unlink
methods.description: Removes the link between a system and a test project.

methods.name: getLinks
methods.description: Retrieves test projects linked to a specific system.

methods.name: getLinkSet
methods.description: Retrieves all links between test projects and systems.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all systems with optional extended info and checks.

methods.name: getLinkedTo
methods.description: Retrieves linkage info for a specific test project.

methods.name: getInterfaceObject
methods.description: Instantiates and returns the interface object associated with a linked system.

methods.name: checkConnection
methods.description: Checks if the connection to a system is valid.
